tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// dge ba'i bshes gnyen zhig la bskur ba'i yi ge bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// gang las sangs rgyas chos tshogs kun 'byung na// dpal 'byor gzhan rnams smos kyang ci 'tshal te// dngos grub rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas nyid shes nas// mtshungs med bla ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// blo chen phyir na lta ba dag /thugs rje che phyir spyod pa dag /dgongs pa zab phyir bsgom pa yang*// dag par bdag gis khyod 'tshal lo// theg mchog tshul khrims bzang po yis// khyod kyi sku lus rnam dag cing*// gsan pa'i tshogs dang ting 'dzin gyis// gsung dang thugs kyang dag pa lags// tshig don mkhas phyir bshad pa dag rigs dbang gyur phyir rtsod pa dag /sdeb sbyor pha rol son pa'i phyir// rtsom pa'i phyir na dag pa'ang khyod// khyod kyis pha rol dgongs pa'i phyir// 'jig rten gsog dang gsob tu gzigs// de phyir 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi// rtog pa rtog par khyod kyis dgongs// de nas chos rnams btang snyoms su// 'jog la ngo mtshar ci zhig mchis// 'on kyang gzhan la ma mthong phyir// khyod kyi ngo mtshar ma lags sam// gser 'gyur rtsi yis lcags bzhin du// tshul khrims pha rol phyin dang thugs// ro gcig gyur pas bcos ma yi// tshul khrims khyod kyis bcos mar gzigs// tshul 'di byis pa'i yul min phyir// byis pa rnams kyis rnam par smad// de 'dra dam pas bsngags pa'i phyir// khyod nyid dam par bdag gis 'tshal// ston pa khyod kyis 'jig rten las// 'das pa'i go 'phang brnyes pa'am// 'on te sngon chad ma brnyes pa// bdag gis ji bzhin ma 'tshal mod// khyod kyi legs bshad seng ge'i sgra// don mthun 'jigs med sgrogs pa dang*// gzhan gyis ma dpyad dpyod pa gang*// 'thad pa dus mas brgyan pa dang*// sdeb sbyor sbyor ba'i snyan ngag gis// ngag gzhan zil gyis gnon pa dang*// nyid kyi don la mi dgongs par// brtse bas gzhan don gzhol ba dang*// zab mo'i snying po thugs chud nas// ting 'dzin snying por mdzad pa sogs// dam pa gzhan la rab dkon pa// khyod la lhun gyis grub pa'i tshul// 'di la dpag na dam pa yi// ye shes rgya mtshor zhugs pa'am// 'on te ring por mi thogs par// 'jug par 'gyur ba nyid lags grang*// 'di 'dra rtogs pas phyir zhing du// ngo mtshar slar zhing 'phel bar 'gyur// de 'dra gang na khyod bzhugs kyang*// nges par thugs su chud gyur cig

/de ltar rab tu dang ba las// 'khrungs pa'i dge ba gang de yis// skye ba dag ni thams cad du// khyod dang khyod nyid 'dra ba'i bshes// sems dpa' rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams dang*// sngon du dran pas nyer sprel te// gzhan gyi don la ro gcig tu// rnam pa kun tu rol par shog /'di ltar brjod par 'dod pa yi// 'dun pa dag pas kun bslangs nas// mngon sum min yang mngon sum bzhin// rnam par bsams nas glengs ba lags// slar yang khyod la mchod pa'i phyir// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin ni// kun bzang rnam 'phrul lta bu yis// mchod cing mchod par bgyid par shog /rin chen dri med gser srang gsum// mar me'i mchod pa'i slad du 'bul// 'bar bas mtshan pa'i gos dang ni// 'gam ha rgyab yol nyid du 'bul// dar yug dmar po ma nyams pa// khyed kyi cod pan slad du 'bul// slar yang gser srang lnga dang ni// dar gos gsum dang rta mchog gsum// rgyal ba bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang*// rdzogs par bgyi ba'i slad du 'bul// der bzhugs dge 'dun thams cad la// chab tsha'i bsnyen bkur zhig kyang 'bul// de las byung ba'i dge ba yang*// dam pa khyod la legs 'bul gyis// khyod kyi dgongs pa gang lags pa// de kun 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig /'gro ba bshes dang bral ba dang*// log pa'i bshes kyis zin gyur pa// de dag thams cad khyod 'dra yi// yang dag bshes kyis rjes 'dzin shog /'gro ba lam dang bral ba dang*// log pa'i lam du zhugs gyur pa// de dag thams cad khyod bzhed pa'i// yang dag lam la 'jug par shog /de ltar mchod par 'os pa legs mchod nas// bsngags par 'os pa bsngags pa'i cha tsam zhig /brjod pa 'di ni blo gros 'jigs med pa// blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal gyis brjod pa yin// shing mo glang gi lo dpyid zla 'bring po'i tshes bcu zhi la/ dpal sa skyar bris/ bkra shis par gyur cig/
// ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
